stops.title: Nkɔsoɔ
stops.caption: Asɔrefoɔ foforɔ, berɛ mu.
stops.speech: Nkɔsoɔ amanneɛbɔ kan asɔrefoɔ foforɔ wɔ berɛ no mu, baabi a wɔbaeɛ, ne sɛdeɛ ɛne abosome a atwam toto.

stops.title: Asɔrefoɔ foforɔ
stops.caption: Baabi a wɔfiri baeɛ.
stops.speech: Nkyekyɛmu no kyerɛ asɔre baa ne ɛkwan a wɔfaa so baeɛ, enti wohunu deɛ ɛde nnipa ba ankasa.
